svg.title: 1. Reference architecture (HLD)
svg.text: Aurora cluster volume: 6 copies of every page across 3 AZs
E-commerce on AWS: multi-AZ reference architecture
One region, three Availability Zones, stateless services on EKS, managed data stores, async work on queues and events
Gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB,
ECR, KMS, Secrets Manager. App traffic
to AWS APIs never uses the NAT gateways.
